name: Deep Design Review
summary: A read-only combo for design analysis, critique, and adversarial review before implementation.

combo.description: Podium-inspired analysis -> critique -> review combo for architecture, design, and absorption decisions.

phases.title: Design Analysis
phases.action: Analyze the target design, constraints, risks, and implementation options without editing files.
phases.verifier: Analysis report cites inspected files, decisions, risks, and recommended path.
phases.stop_condition: Analysis report is reviewed or bridged into the mission.

phases.title: Design Critique
phases.action: Challenge the analysis for hidden assumptions, duplication, unsafe scope, and weak verifiers.
phases.command: uaf delegate --mission {{mission_id}} --lane redteam --scope "<analysis artifact or design scope>" --launch --profile {{profile}} --report --timeout-ms 0
phases.verifier: Critique report identifies blockers, tradeoffs, and false-rigor risks.
phases.stop_condition: Critique is accepted, rejected, or converted into requested changes.

phases.title: Adversarial Review
phases.action: Use the selected reviewer brand to review the analysis and critique, then recommend proceed, revise, or stop.
phases.command: uaf adversarial-review --from codex --brand {{combo_brand}} --mission {{mission_id}} --scope "<design scope>" --prompt "Review the design analysis and critique. Findings first. Decide whether implementation should proceed, be revised, or stop." --profile {{profile}} --timeout-ms 0
phases.verifier: Reviewer verdict is recorded and orchestrator decision accepts or requests changes.
